title: Persist versioned project records in IndexedDB
description: Store minimal `LabelProject` records as versioned durable values through a feature-oriented IndexedDB repository so identities, names, and timestamps survive browser restart.
acceptanceCriteria: A versioned minimal project record contains identity, name, schema version, created timestamp, and updated timestamp
Project UI operations use a feature-oriented repository rather than direct IndexedDB calls
Create and rename transactions persist complete records atomically
Persisted projects reappear with the same identity and name after a browser-context restart
IndexedDB failures return an actionable error and never produce a false success state

steps.details: Create the versioned minimal `LabelProject` record and validation boundary, including stable ID, normalized name, schema version, and deterministic timestamp fields.
Implement a feature-oriented repository with list, get, put, and delete operations over one IndexedDB object store; contain browser API details inside the adapter.
Route create, open, rename, list, and delete behavior through the repository and update visible state only after the durable operation succeeds.
Create and rename a project, close the browser context without clearing storage, reopen it, and assert the same ID and name are loaded from IndexedDB.
Inject or simulate an IndexedDB rejection and assert an actionable error is shown while the prior visible and durable state remains truthful.

technicalNotes: Use IndexedDB, not localStorage, as the durable boundary.
Keep migration metadata explicit even though the first schema has no prior migration.
